gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2121 experienced an overall deterioration of GBP 2.9 million in prior year claims provisions during 2020. This strengthening was primarily driven by deteriorations in Energy (GBP 1.3m), Property (GBP 2.1m), Casualty (GBP 1.6m), and Reinsurance - Specialty (GBP 2.6m). These adverse movements were partially offset by releases in Motor (GBP 0.6m), Marine (GBP 1.3m), and Pecuniary Loss (GBP 2.7m). The 2018 and 2019 underwriting years were particularly affected by COVID-19 related losses, with ongoing uncertainties and legal rulings impacting the final outcome, leading to the 2018 year of account remaining open. Other significant events impacting prior years included various natural catastrophes like California wildfires, Hawaiian volcanic eruptions, Hurricanes Michael and Florence, Typhoon Jebi in 2018, and Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai, Hurricane Dorian, Australian bushfires, and floods in Townsville and Wisconsin in 2019. Man-made losses from prior years included fires in the Hamptons and a Brazilian warehouse, and political risks losses.
